HAMMER_MOD_POWER_HAMMER_STUN_POWER.title: Stun
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_HAMMER_STUN_POWER.descr: [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Stun has accumulated. Every enemy starts with a threshold of 10; its next threshold doubles after each stun.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_HAMMER_STUN_RESISTANCE_: This enemy's Stun threshold has increased.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_OVERCHARGE_POWER.title: Overcharge
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_OVERCHARGE_POWER.descri: All Charge-release cards cost 0 and resolve at full Charge this turn.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_OVERCHARGE_BACKLASH_POW: At the start of next turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Weak and Vulnerable.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FOCUS_POWER.title: Focus
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FOCUS_POWER.description: At the start of each turn, gain Charge, or draw if Charge is full. Upgraded copies draw an additional card.
The first time each turn you fully release 3 Charge, gain Energy and draw.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_DASH_JUICE_POWER.title: Dash Juice
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_DASH_JUICE_POWER.descri: Unblocked enemy attack damage no longer clears Charge.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FELYNE_KO_TECHNIQUE_POW: Attacks add extra Stun based on the Energy actually spent plus a fixed bonus.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_PILE_DRIVER_POWER.title: Pile Driver
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_PILE_DRIVER_POWER.descr: Each stack makes Attacks deal 50% more damage to enemies with Stun, or 100% more damage if they are Stunned.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_CONCUSSION_RESONANCE_PO: Applying Weak or Vulnerable adds [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Stun.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_IMPACT_BURST_POWER.desc: Whenever you deal a hit of damage to an enemy, add [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Stun to it.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FACE_OFF_POWER.title: Face Off
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FACE_OFF_POWER.descript: The chosen enemy deals 100% less attack damage to you. Removed at the end of the enemy turn.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_FACE_OFF_POWER.smartDes: {ApplierName} deals 100% less attack damage to you. Removed at the end of the enemy turn.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_WATER_STANCE_POWER.desc: When attacked, deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] damage to the attacker. Removed at the start of your next turn.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_COUNTER_FORM_POWER.desc: The first time each turn you use an Attack on an enemy that intends to attack, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Block after it resolves.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_AFTERSHOCK_POWER.title: Aftershock
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_AFTERSHOCK_POWER.descri: At the start of the applier's next turn, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Stun.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_COUNTERSTRIKE_RECOVERY_: At the start of your next turn, gain 1 Charge and 6 Block.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_ADAMANT_SEED_POWER.desc: Until the start of your next turn, enemy attacks cannot reduce your Charge.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_CHALLENGER_POWER.title: Challenger
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_CHALLENGER_POWER.descri: At the start of each turn, if any enemy intends to attack, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Strength this turn.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_WIREBUG_CONTINUATION_PO: Whenever you play a card that actually spends at least 2 Energy, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Charge.
Attacks deal [blue]{Amount}[/blue]% more damage to Vulnerable enemies.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_CHARGE_SWITCH_COURAGE_P: Whenever you fully release 3 Charge, gain [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Strength.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_PARTBREAKER_POWER.title: Partbreaker
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_PARTBREAKER_POWER.descr: After an Attack resolves, apply [blue]{Amount}[/blue] Vulnerable once to each surviving enemy that took unblocked Attack damage.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_COMBO_BOOST_POWER.title: Hyper Combo
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_COMBO_BOOST_POWER.descr: Attacks that would hit at least twice hit [blue]{Amount}[/blue] additional times.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_BLOOD_RITE_POWER.title: Restrained Lifesteal
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_BLOOD_RITE_POWER.descri: Whenever one instance of damage you deal to an enemy causes more than 10 HP loss, heal [blue]{Amount}[/blue] HP for every 10 HP lost. Overkill does not count.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_HAND_CRANKED_TRACTOR_PO: This turn, each of the next [blue]{Amount}[/blue] cards you play that releases Charge releases one additional time. All releases use the Charge level before the first release.
HAMMER_MOD_POWER_MARATHON_HAMMERER_POWER: Each stack grants Strength equal to your current Charge. It updates whenever your Charge changes.
